title: Phone text fields stay 16px in landscape, and the zoom check names the field (RF-189 review follow-ups)
acceptance: The 16px phone text-field rule also applies on a touch screen under 640px tall (a phone turned sideways, wider than sm), so a landscape iPhone does not zoom on focus; tablets and desktops keep their own sizes.

The e2e zoom check uses the same media query as index.css, checks the sign-up form at 844x390 on the touch phone project, and its failure message falls back from aria-label to id to name (`||`, since a missing id is "").

evidence.summary: Owner pre-approved RF-196 (the reserved ID for the #726 final review follow-ups) for the 2026-11-05 unattended Neo session.

Neo local: the new landscape check failed on a build without the CSS change (sign-up (landscape): form fields under 16px), and the full smoke passed at 1440 and 390 (2 passed) with it; startup entry 179.37 kB gzip.

resolution: index.css applies the 16px text-field rule with (max-width: 639.98px), (pointer: coarse) and (max-height: 639.98px), so a sideways phone no longer zooms; the e2e check shares that query, re-checks sign-up at 844x390 on the touch project, and names the field with an aria-label || id || name fallback.
